name: Forcecage

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: ruby dust worth 1,500+ GP, which the spell consumes

summary: An invisible, immobile prison of force (a 20-foot barred cage or a solid 10-foot box) traps the creatures inside.
text: Creatures wholly inside the cage or box are trapped and can't leave by nonmagical means; creatures partly inside are pushed out. Teleporting or planar travel out needs a Charisma save first (a failure wastes the attempt), a solid box also blocks spells in or out, and Dispel Magic can't end it.
